aldric_shadow.name: Blackguard Aldric
aldric_shadow.desc: Obsidian plate with a violet sheen. The crimson cape stays.

aldric_gilded.name: Sunforged Aldric
aldric_gilded.desc: Polished gold plate fit for a lord commander.

thorgrim_shadow.name: Thorgrim the Black
thorgrim_shadow.desc: Blackened iron helm, mail and crossbow.

thorgrim_gilded.name: Goldbeard Thorgrim

tavra_shadow.name: Obsidian Tavra
tavra_shadow.desc: Her golden plate turned to black glass.

korga_frost.name: Frostfang Korga
korga_frost.desc: Ice-blue steel and a frost-touched bow.

zizzik_arcane.name: Starweave Zizzik
zizzik_arcane.desc: His singed orange robe swapped for royal blue.

seraphine_shadow.name: Seraphine of the Veil
seraphine_shadow.desc: Black robes of a priestess who walks among the dead.
